verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail has a published check-deposit page. It states that deposits are pay-per-deposit with no setup or monthly fees, and that bundling multiple checks saves money. However, the evidence contains no actual fee amounts and none of the other terms the story asks for. Missing for 10: supported banks, specific per-deposit fee amounts, deposit turnaround time, what happens to the physical check after deposit, and independent corroboration.
